title: Bows and shields: round 3 variations
desc: Three new builds each of 842's B1a, B3a, B3b, B3c, H2a, H2c and H3b (J rated them IMPROVE with no note); each keeps its parent's idea and is built a different way. Hand-held shields are held from behind on grip bars and never touch the arms.

takes.name: swept riser: reflex + Warren truss
takes.facts: swept bar bent reflex over a zigzag Warren-truss spine; oval ports light at full draw; solid limbs, hybrid cams; single-pin scope; 3-vane lighted nock

takes.name: swept riser: round tube, twin spines
takes.facts: swept bar as a round tube with glowing collar ports, twin spines either side; split limbs, binary cams roll 220; 5-pin; long rod + 2 back bars

takes.name: swept riser: blade + ladder, ports count
takes.facts: swept deep blade with a ladder truss to an arc spine; 8 ports light one by one on the draw; single cam + idler; 3-pin

takes.name: W1 plate: slots, rear-deploy heads
takes.facts: W1 plate with long rimmed slots; single cam; 3-pin; hip quiver; 3-blade rear-deploying heads swing back in the foam

takes.name: W1 plate: split plates, claw heads
takes.facts: two thin W1 plates with a gap held by glowing spacer bolts, slide together as it forms; binary cams; 5-pin; long 2-blade claw heads open forward

takes.name: W1 plate: big windows, spinning heads
takes.facts: W1 plate with two big glowing-rimmed windows; 7 pins in one column; 5-arrow quiver; 4-blade heads spin as they open

takes.name: truss: space frame, scanning laser
takes.facts: 3D space-frame carbon riser (two chords each side, cross tubes); laser scans the target 11-17 and counts 6, 12, 18; slider pin drops; 3-blade heads

takes.name: truss: bowstring truss, laser pulses
takes.facts: bowstring-truss riser (curved front chord, straight back chord); rangefinder on the end of the front rod fires 3 pulses 12-17, reads 18; solid limbs, binary; 2-blade

takes.name: truss: K-truss, ring ranges
takes.facts: K-truss riser with hex-nut nodes; the ring arm leads and points at the target 8-15, a laser from the ring reads 18; slider pin drops; then the draw

takes.name: cube riser: twisted helix, two shots
takes.facts: half-pixel cubes in a twisted double helix; release 25; a twist wave rolls through the cubes 26-31 as the 2nd arrow comes from the quiver; release 43

takes.name: cube riser: outline, arrow from ring
takes.facts: cubes trace only the riser outline (solid at the grip); no quiver: the 2nd arrow is built at the hand from ring cubes 27-32; release 25 and 45

takes.name: cube riser: checker, three shots
takes.facts: dense checker of small cubes 2 wide x 3 deep; three fast shots from the 6-arrow quiver, release 23, 38, 53; 2-blade heads

takes.name: curved brick: arch top, laid brick by brick
takes.facts: curved BR1 tower 1.0 x 1.9 with a round arch top and keystone; each brick flies in from the ring 5-13; held from behind on two grip bars; hit knocks near bricks back, they settle

takes.name: curved brick: barrel stack bond, mortar flash
takes.facts: BR1 bricks in stack bond on a barrel surface (curved both ways), rim frame; columns rise from the ground 5-13; hit flashes the bricks outward from the impact

takes.name: curved brick: herringbone folding screen
takes.facts: five flat facets angled into a curve, faced with BR1 herringbone; facets unfold from the centre 6-16; the hit punches one brick out, it flies back and re-seats

takes.name: telescoping heater: sideways fan
takes.facts: 7 upright H1 columns slide out sideways from the centre into a 1.0 x 1.7 heater (5-13); hit shivers the columns sideways in a wave

takes.name: telescoping heater: nested rings
takes.facts: 5 nested heater-outline frames filled with H1 telescope forward and out from a boss (6-15) like a collapsible cup; hit pushes the rings back in depth order

takes.name: telescoping heater: roller shutter
takes.facts: header bar over the grips, 9 thin hinged H1 slats unroll down into the heater outline 6-18; hit swings the hinged slats back in a ripple down the chain

takes.name: planted wall: drawbridge ribs
takes.facts: push; ground line 1.6 ahead; 9 curved ribs lying flat swing up on hinges at the line (6-15) arching over like a quarter dome, H1 panels fill; hit bends the struck ribs

takes.name: planted wall: hex columns
takes.facts: push; a curved band of 29 H1 hex columns extrudes up from the ground line 1.6 ahead (6-14), leaning in like a dome; hit sinks the struck columns, they pop back

takes.name: planted wall: sliding screens
takes.facts: push; a post plants 1.6 ahead (5-8), three curved H1 screens slide out of it sideways (8-16), leaning in like a dome; hit shoves the screens, dent ring
